objective: Make the root ask again when an answer to its question clarifies without choosing, and fix the setup command's restart rule on dry runs.
scope: Incident in another session: the root asked a direction question through AskUserQuestion; the user's answer was a clarification (what they meant by randomly placed stars) and picked no option; the root treated it as no answer and went ahead on its recommended default; the user replied "YOU DIDNT ASK ME AGAIN???????? you were supposed to". Cause: the rule 'when the user does not answer, proceed on the recommended default' in root/asking.md.

New rule, in requirements.md first, then root/asking.md (and the user-busy skill if it restates defaults), then rebuild dist with bun packages/integrations/claude/build.ts: an answer that clarifies, comments or adds a constraint without choosing an option is not a choice; fold it into the question and ask again. The recommended default applies only when the user gives no answer at all or has said they are away (user-busy). When the user asked to be asked whenever something is ambiguous, ask before acting on any remaining ambiguity.

Also: packages/integrations/claude/src/setup-command.md tells the user to restart whenever the report has a '+' line, which also appears on --dry-run; restrict the restart to a real (non-dry) run that changed settings.
constraints: Shorten nothing else; keep every existing detail.
Add a test mapping for the new requirement like the others.
Another writer is changing packages/runtime/src/state, cli/migrate.ts and their tests; do not edit them. Rebuild dist after they finish is handled by your run: rebuild at the end.
No version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; report changed paths.
Keep working until done; when done and checked, stop and report. Respond tersely.

criteria.text: Re-ask: requirements.md and root/asking.md state that a clarifying or commenting answer that picks no option is folded into the question and asked again, and the default applies only with no answer or when the user is away; the requirement is mapped in the plugin test
Ambiguity: when the user asked to be asked about ambiguities, the root asks before acting on a remaining one
Setup restart: setup-command.md asks for a restart only after a non-dry run that changed settings
Gates: bun check, bun lint, bun fmt --check and bun test exit 0 after rebuilding dist
